questĭo , ōnis, f. queror,
I.a complaining, complaint: “habebat enim flebile quiddam in questionibus aptumque ad misericordiam commovendam,” Cic. Brut. 38, 142 Orell. (B. and K. ex conj. Lambin.: conquestionibus).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
